rules.statement: The district judge has discretion to inspect a document before deciding a claim of privilege.
rules.supporting_quote: In the circumstances the learned district Judge was not justified in refusing to examine the letter and it is only after inspection that the court should decide the question of privilege. It must not be understood that in every case a judge is compelled to inspect a document in order to decide the claim of privilege. The section makes it clear that the court may inspect a document if it sees fit so that the matter is one within the discretion of the District Judge
